principle: Modules are stable team-side lenses onto shared project data. They do not own independent copies of project truth.
state_posture: Dashboard status is a view of governed/project state, not authority. Field truth state feeds readiness/output/routing state and must remain visible.

modules.label: Project Origin / PAC
modules.description: Known, approved, and structurally defined project-start origin data derived from PAC.
operator_questions: What was known at origin?
What remains validation-required before startup?
What cannot be overwritten by later operations?

modules.label: Activation Gates
modules.description: Blocking-by-default startup sufficiency checks before project activation proceeds.
operator_questions: Can this project start responsibly?
Which required startup facts are still gaps?
Which overrides create coordination risk?

modules.label: Scope / Project Definition
modules.description: Operational view of scope, project description, square footage, services, exclusions, and later scope clarification.
operator_questions: What is actually included?
Where is the proposal narrative incomplete or misaligned?
What scope signals trigger consultant or additional-service routing?

modules.label: Contracts / Authorization
modules.description: Agreement path, acceptance, authorization, Service Order logic, insurance, and contractual workflow constraints.
operator_questions: What authorizes the work?
Does the contract path match the work being performed?
Which UHG-specific contractual rules govern this project?

modules.label: Budget / Financial Model
modules.description: Transforms PAC fee and cost origin data into internal production budget and project financial controls.
operator_questions: What is the approved fee basis?
How does fee transform into production budget?
Where does budget depend on contract or compensation data?

modules.label: Compensation / Fee
modules.description: Professional fee, phase fee breakdown, reimbursables, additional services, and compensation assumptions.
operator_questions: What is Grace being paid to do?
What fee data is origin truth vs. later transformation?
What additional services are unresolved?

modules.label: Schedule / Milestones
modules.description: Project schedule by phase, schedule confidence, milestones, and owner/client-dependent timing constraints.
operator_questions: What schedule is contractual vs. illustrative?
Which milestones drive deliverables and billing?
Where is false precision being introduced?

modules.label: Team + Responsibility
modules.description: Internal, consultant, owner, and partner responsibilities that emerge after origin capture.
operator_questions: Who owns each required action?
Which consultant/additional-service triggers remain unrouted?
What responsibilities are missing or ambiguous?

modules.label: Consultants / Partners
modules.description: Consultant needs, partner assignments, proposal requests, scope mapping, and coordination status.
operator_questions: Which consultants are required by scope?
Which consultant scopes are missing?
Which assignments affect schedule, fee, or risk?

modules.label: LCD-W / Project Analysis
modules.description: Required project-analysis fields from the generic Grace LCD-W pattern or the UHG-specific contractual LCD/LCW overlay.
operator_questions: Which project-analysis fields are required for this client/project?
Which are generic Grace needs vs. UHG contractual fields?
Which required fields remain incomplete?

modules.label: System Setup
modules.description: Operational configuration: folders, platforms, model environment, standards, and project setup requirements.
operator_questions: Is the project environment ready?
What setup requirements are blocked by missing data?
What setup facts need validation?

modules.label: Risk / Gaps / Archive
modules.description: Visible worklist of missing, conflicting, uncertain, archived/source-preserved, or unresolved project facts. Quarantine is not a console function; unresolved material is carried by field truth/admissibility/verification/routing state.
operator_questions: What do we not know?
What is blocked?
What source/dialogue needs archive preservation?
What needs human concurrence before propagation?
